# Verdict — open-source Apollo alternative

> Cold-outreach engine that verifies every mailbox before sending. Pattern discovery from public web. SMTP verification gate. Sub-4% bounce.

- Demo: https://tryverdict.org
- API: `POST /api/verify` · `POST /api/gate` · `POST /api/discover`
- License: MIT
- Stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, dnspython

## Alternatives replaced

Apollo.io · Hunter.io · Instantly.ai · Clay · Smartlead · Lemlist
